notes.title: Ending 2 bugfix
notes.notes: -Fixed a bug that prevented players from unlocking ending 2. The reason? I wrote “cd” instead of “CD” in the code. Programming errors are like politicians, the dumber, the more dangerous.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
-Changed the trigger warning screen to include mentions of disorienting visual effects
-Fixed a typo on the difficulty selection menu (How did this slip in?)

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes: Added a combat tutorial for chill difficulty since the default one was not appearing due to being tied to the (disabled in chill) random battles.

notes.title: Quick bugfix
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug that made the "Not a Safe Place" exit door lead nowhere.
-Fixed a series of dumb mistakes that made the final vending machines unable to give the CD collectibles.

notes.title: Minor demo update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made some enemy bullets phase through the player’s real body even if they touched it.
[*] Reworked the pause menu.
[*] Added the option to disable the dither effect.
[/list]
